wire.CREATE: 0x5580 INT32 byte count + code; 0x5581 BYTE result

wire.CHECK: 0x5590 one string; 0x5591 BYTE result/BYTE tries, result10 at threshold
wire.GETLOCKTIME: 0x5592 empty; 0x5593 BYTE hours/BYTE minutes (hours modulo24); expired returns0x5589 with0,0
